environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has AWS WAF v2 WebACL attached with two rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) Priority 0: A custom rule with a RegexPatternSet matching on query string parameters using pattern `(?i)(union\s+select|'\s*or\s*'|--\s*$|;\s*drop|;\s*select|'\s*;)` with action BLOCK, and (2) Priority 1: AWS managed rule group AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with all rules in default (BLOCK) action including body, query string, URI, and header inspection via sensitivity level HIGH. Additionally, the ECS task role IAM policy has no S3/network egress permissions, and the Fargate task runs in a private subnet with egress only through a NAT gateway that has VPC Flow Logs enabled with CloudWatch alerting on anomalous outbound data volume exceeding 1KB/minute to non-allowlisted destinations.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with WAF v2 WebACL
config.network: private subnet, NAT-only egress, VPC Flow Logs with anomaly alerting
config.ecs_task_role: no s3:*, no ec2:*, only logs:PutLogEvents and ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
config.data_exfil_alert: CloudWatch alarm on NAT gateway BytesOut > 1024 bytes/min to non-allowlisted IPs
